name: Gurtenfestival (50 years)
description: Bern's big mixed-genre festival on the Gurten hill, 5 days for the 50th
price: n/a (5-day pass presale 4 Nov 2026, 4-day early bird 25 Nov 2026)
details:
Anniversary edition: the Gurtenfestival turns 50 and runs five days instead of four, with the Sunday back. 2026 drew a record 104,750 visitors (27,000 per sold-out day). Reached by funicular or on foot from Wabern; camping on the hill.

Two headliners are booked, the first act is revealed on 3 Dec 2026, the line-up in mid-December. Patent Ochsner play the Sunday. Ticket presale: 5-day passes from 4 Nov 2026 17:00, 4-day early bird from 25 Nov 2026.
